newsitem.title: INDIA: ONGC to select partner for Neelam oil fiel.
newsitem.headline: ONGC to select partner for Neelam oil fiel.

text.p: India's state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC) is looking for suitable companies with expertise to enhance oil recovery at Neelam oil fields in Bombay offshore, a company spokesman said on Monday.
"ONGC might go in for suitable companies with the requisite expertise in this area," the spokesman told Reuters. "We will short list them and then go ahead."
"I don't think there will be a normal tender route," the spokesman said.
The ONGC board has approved a proposal for a joint venture partner to improve recovery and enhance yields from the Neelam oilfields.
The Neelam oil fields currently produces 2.5 to 2.8 million tonnes of crude annually but optimum output should be 3.5 million tonnes.
The spokesman said a few companies with expertise had shown interest in the venture. He declined to give other details.
